title: test(cli): spawn the source entry under node, not the tsx binary, in 34 test files
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6ekcr8QawcG79EtN7Tzdbo)_

Part of #23181 (slice 29, the tsx wrapper lever across the cli test files outside slices 24–28). The card stays open for later slices.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`packages/cli` 里 34 个测试文件起 CLI 子进程时，不再经 `node_modules/.bin/tsx` 包一层，改为用当前进程自己的 `node`(`process.execPath`)直接跑 `bin/run-dev.js`，与 slice 12 对 migrate 文件的做法一致。入口、`src/`、`NODE_ENV=development`、子进程的 env、cwd、参数、超时都不变。
- **为什么改**：卡 #23181 的测试提速职责。tsx 包装只多出一个进程和一次自身的转译，每次子进程白付几秒；slice 27 实测同一条命令 tsx 9.5–11.8 s、node 5.3–5.4 s，stdout 字节相同。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试文件，不发布任何东西(cli 的 `files[]` 只有 dist、README、CHANGELOG)；没有改任何断言、用例名、超时、分层或 `// test-budget:` 头；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/test/generate-skill.e2e.test.ts`(唯一手改：CLI 走 node，解析探针是裸 `.ts` 文件，仍走 tsx)；`packages/cli/test/package-install-local-handlers.integration.test.ts`(`os start` 启动走 node)；其余 32 个文件只是 `TSX` → `process.execPath` 并删掉常量。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/build-strict-body-count.test.ts` → 6/6 通过，墙钟约 26 s(改前约 33 s)。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The order lists 45 `packages/cli` test files that still name `tsx` on `origin/main` outside slices 24–28 and `test/helpers/**`. I sorted each one first.

**(a) The switch applies: 34 files.** Each spawned `bin/run-dev.js` through the tsx binary, and none of them is about that entry. Each now spawns `process.execPath` with `bin/run-dev.js` as the first argument, slice 12's way. The child env, cwd, argv, stdin, `maxBuffer` and timeouts are unchanged. The local `const TSX` (or the `TSX` import from the shared helper) goes, a runner named `runTsx` whose every call spawns the CLI is renamed `runCli`, and the prose that said "through tsx" now says `node`.

`src/commands/validate-json-strict-exit.e2e` · `test/build-callable-names` · `build-connector-spec-file-artifact.e2e` · `build-demo-staff-artifact` · `build-docs-step-count.e2e` · `build-runtime-bundle-bodyless` · `build-seed-files-artifact.e2e` · `build-strict-body-count` · `build-view-container-name` · `create-refuses-invalid-project-name.e2e` · `dev-no-watch.pin` · `generate-agent-retired.e2e` · `generate-object-namespace-prefix.e2e` · `generate-refuses-name-outside-charset` · `generate-refuses-unimportable-alias` · `generate-refuses-unparseable-name` · `generate-skill.e2e` · `hook-body-build-reach.e2e` · `migrate-apply-refuses-before-ddl.e2e` · `migrate-exit-code.e2e` · `migrate-unloadable-host-config-exit.e2e` · `package-install-local-handlers.integration` · `qa-names-and-tags-run` · `qa-requires-skip-run` · `refusal-renders-once.e2e` · `retry-policy-key-validate-door` · `rule-line-explain-pointer.e2e` · `scaffold-emission-policy.e2e` · `serve-host-config-metadata-door.integration` · `stack-datasource-default-validate-door` · `validate-field-predicate-traversal` · `validate-json-warning-parity.e2e` · `validate-top-level-strict.e2e` · `validate-view-container-name`

- `generate-skill.e2e` is the one mixed file. Its two CLI spawns move to node. Its parse probe imports a generated bare `.ts` module with an extensionless specifier, which plain node cannot load, so the probe stays on the tsx binary through a two-argument `runChild(bin, args, cwd)`.
- `migrate-apply-refuses-before-ddl.e2e`, `migrate-unloadable-host-config-exit.e2e`, `qa-names-and-tags-run`, `qa-requires-skip-run`, `package-install-local-handlers.integration` and `serve-host-config-metadata-door.integration` imported `TSX` from `test/helpers/serve-process.ts` but spawn in their own code, so only the import changes; the helper is untouched.
- The tier is unchanged: `vitest-tiers.ts` still reads every file as a spawner through its `run-dev.js` entry name.

**(b) Already on node, or tsx in prose only: 6 files, nothing to do.**

| file | why |
|:--|:--|
| `src/commands/child-env-source-loader.pin` | spawns nothing; tsx appears in prose and in a specimen string |
| `src/commands/migrate/plan.declared-default-datasource.integration` | slice 12 moved it to `process.execPath`; prose only |
| `src/commands/migrate/plan.telemetry-sibling.integration` | same |
| `src/commands/dev-database-directory` | already `process.execPath`; `--import tsx` loads an inline `-e` script that imports `src/` (`.js` specifiers onto `.ts` files), not the CLI entry, and plain node cannot resolve those |
| `src/utils/make-directory` | same shape as `dev-database-directory` |
| `test/serve-built-cli-prerequisite` | spawns nothing; tsx in prose only |

**(c) The test pins the tsx or `run-dev.js` entry itself: 5 files, keep tsx.**

| file | why |
|:--|:--|
| `test/run-dev-cwd-tsconfig-redirect.e2e` | its subject is tsx honouring the cwd tsconfig and the shim's re-exec with `TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH` |
| `test/start-signal-forwarding.e2e` | already `process.execPath`, with the tsx loader as `--import` on purpose: the tsx CLI would put a relay process between the test and the pid it signals |
| `test/invocation-loudness.e2e` | pins what a shell sees when the package barrel `src/index.ts` is run as if it were the CLI (only tsx runs a bare `.ts` file), plus the shims' own success path |
| `test/released-port-production-spawn.pin` | a source census; spawns nothing; `TSX` appears only in specimen sources and in its own vocabulary |
| `test/unbuilt-workspace-lead.test` | spawns nothing; pins the remedy text, which names tsx |

Not changed: no assertion, expected output, case name, timeout, tier, project, `// test-budget:` header or test helper. No source file.

## Tests

- **A/B** (one box, one lock hold, N=3, `--maxWorkers=1`, base and head interleaved, base first in rounds 1 and 3, head first in round 2): for each base leg the base file's bytes were written into the same path and restored from `HEAD` after it, checked by blob hash, so both legs ran in the same tier slot. `.e2e` files ran with `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`, the rest with `queue` (the queue tier writes the oclif test manifest once per run, as in CI). Whole process wall per run, in seconds:

  | file | command | base | head | mean | change |
  |:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|
  | `build-strict-body-count` | `os build` | 36.2, 31.5, 32.7 | 26.6, 26.6, 26.0 | 33.5 → 26.4 | −21.0% |
  | `generate-refuses-unparseable-name` | `os generate` | 20.3, 20.9, 20.6 | 18.1, 18.6, 18.4 | 20.6 → 18.4 | −10.9% |
  | `validate-view-container-name` | `os validate` | 32.3, 31.6, 31.6 | 28.9, 28.2, 28.8 | 31.8 → 28.6 | −10.0% |
  | `qa-requires-skip-run` | `os qa` | 14.7, 13.3, 14.6 | 13.5, 13.2, 14.1 | 14.2 → 13.6 | −4.2% |
  | `dev-no-watch.pin` | `os dev` | 53.2, 49.7, 50.4 | 41.4, 42.6, 41.0 | 51.1 → 41.6 | −18.5% |
  | `migrate-exit-code.e2e` | `os migrate` | 40.2, 37.7, 39.3 | 23.8, 23.1, 23.2 | 39.1 → 23.4 | −40.1% |
  | `create-refuses-invalid-project-name.e2e` | `os create` | 43.8, 42.2, 46.1 | 28.6, 28.9, 30.1 | 44.0 → 29.2 | −33.7% |

  Every leg exit 0, with the same test count on both sides (6, 13, 5, 7, 8, 5, 6). The saving is larger on the nightly `.e2e` files, which run without the queue tier's oclif manifest, so each tsx spawn there also paid the full command import twice over.
- **All 34 switched files on head** `01d2b0d5` (and again on the merged head, below): queue tier 17/17 files, 125/125 tests; nightly tier 17/17 files, 113/113 tests.
- Same output through both binaries: `node bin/run-dev.js --version` and `tsx bin/run-dev.js --version` give byte-identical stdout and stderr on this tree.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0.
- No ablation: test-only, no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The biggest remaining tsx lever is the shared helper.** `test/helpers/serve-process.ts` exports `TSX`, and `runServe()` spawns `serve` through it; 20 cli test files call `runServe(`. The order keeps `test/helpers/**` out of this slice because slices 24–28 run on top of it. Carrier: #23181.
- **`invocation-loudness.e2e` could move half.** Its two `bin/run-dev.js` spawns (`dev --no-ui`, `--version`) share one runner with the barrel spawns. Kept on tsx as the order names the file, which pins the shims. Carrier: #23181.
- **`package-install-local-handlers.integration`'s line-2 header still says "the tsx source entry".** The order forbids touching `// test-budget:` headers in this slice; the next shard-timings refresh resizes and can reword it.
- **`skip-changeset`.** Test-only. `@objectstack/cli`'s `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; `test/` and `src/**/*.test.ts` do not build into `dist/`, so no `files[]` content changes.

## Verification

All readings on head `b2400351` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), the merge of `origin/main` after slices 25, 26 and 27 landed (#28601, #28599, #28592). None of them touched these 34 files; the merge had no conflict.

- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gives 52 families. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe, after a full `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (118/118 tasks) on the merged tree. `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 52 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 52 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. On the pre-merge head `01d2b0d5` the same set (51 families) was green too; there `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 (an unbuilt `@objectstack/connector-slack`) and read 0 after the full build, and `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needed its positive-control commit fetched on the shallow clone.
- **The 34 switched files on the merged head:** queue tier 17/17 files, 125/125 tests; nightly tier 17/17 files, 113/113 tests.
- **Hand gates:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 34 files exit 0 (`@objectstack/cli` has no `lint` script; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` runs in CI). `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0.
- **CI** families (Test Core with both cli tiers, the nightly `.e2e` tier on `main`, the lint farm, the type-check lanes) are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
- Evidence (gate lists with exit codes for both heads, every A/B row, the A/B script): `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s29/` in the project files.
